title: Everyday Phrases — When the Power Goes Out
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🔦 實用「停電之夜」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — When the Power Goes Out
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「停電之夜」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是鄰居：停電的晚上：燈一暗先找手機和手電筒、檢查總開關，問鄰居是不是整條街都停，冰箱先別開，點蠟燭吃現成的晚餐、到陽台看星星，電來了檢查電器、把燈關掉睡覺。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'When the Power Goes Out' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A power cut at night: finding a torch, checking the breaker, asking a neighbour, keeping the fridge shut, eating by candlelight, and checking the appliances when the power returns. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is everything suddenly dark?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The power went out again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the lights just go out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the whole room is dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my phone right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the nightstand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot see anything at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold my hand and wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the flashlight in the kitchen?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is in the drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which drawer holds the flashlight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bottom one beside the stove.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you walk without any light?
dialogue.zh: 你能在沒有燈的情況下走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can feel the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The power is gone, it seems.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a fuse just blew.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is almost out of power.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst aʊt əv ˈpaʊər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it for emergencies tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much battery does it have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only ten percent is left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us use the phone for light.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs juz ðə foʊn fɔr laɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen is bright enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you leave the candles?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are behind the cereal boxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have any matches here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in the top cupboard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who turned off the main switch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody touched it, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp is completely out now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every bulb in here is dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the heating still working now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the fan is silent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that strange clicking sound?
dialogue.zh: 那個奇怪的喀噠聲是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes from the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the fridge so quiet now?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə frɪdʒ soʊ ˈkwaɪət naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱現在怎麼這麼安靜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stopped when the lights went out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑpt wɛn ðə laɪts wɛnt aʊt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we open the refrigerator less?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep the cold inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us not open the fridge often.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs nɑt ˈoʊpən ðə frɪdʒ ˈɔfən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, the food must stay cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə ðə fud mʌst steɪ koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 好主意，食物得保持低溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the emergency candles kept?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the box under the sink.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you found the flashlight yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it works very well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please shine it toward the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The batteries are quite old.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The flashlight battery seems quite low.
dialogue.zh: 手電筒的電好像很弱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We need new ones tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the streetlights on outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the street is black.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the main switch box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is near the front door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you reach the breaker box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I have a small ladder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which switch controls the living room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one marked with tape.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the main breaker down?
dialogue.zh: 總開關為什麼跳下來了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe too many things ran.
dialogue.zh: 也許是同時用了太多電器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me count the small switches.
dialogue.zh: 讓我數一數這些小開關。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are eight of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anything still getting power?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, everything is off now.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，現在全部都斷電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the red light mean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows the circuit failed.
dialogue.zh: 它顯示這條回路故障了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we flip the big switch?
dialogue.zh: 我們該扳那個大開關嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but stand back first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing happened when I tried.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the problem is outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who should we call about this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the power company tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚也許打給電力公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will the power stay off?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ wɪl ðə ˈpaʊər steɪ ɔf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The website says until one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the neighbors have power too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, their windows are dark.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，他們窗戶都是暗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look across the street for lights.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole block is black.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it only our building tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the corner shop is dark.
dialogue.zh: 不是，轉角的店也是暗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the whole neighborhood lost power.
dialogue.zh: 也許整個社區都停電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see candles in windows.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The man next door is outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is holding a flashlight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is he walking to our gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz hi ˈwɔkɪŋ tu ˈaʊər ɡeɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 他為什麼走向我們家門口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wants to ask about this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we ask him what happened?
dialogue.zh: 我們要問他發生什麼事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he may know something.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the power usually come from?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə ˈpaʊər ˈjuʒuəli kʌm frʌm?/
dialogue.zh: 電力通常是從哪裡來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the station on the hill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our neighbor says his lights flickered.
dialogue.zh: 鄰居說他家的燈閃了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the power is weak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear the sirens far away?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hɪr ðə ˈsaɪrənz fɑr əˈweɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽到遠處的警笛聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they sound very distant.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many houses are dark outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every single one on this street.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The streetlamp by the school is off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstritˌlæmp baɪ ðə skul ɪz ɔf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So it is not just us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a relief in some way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə rɪˈlif ɪn sʌm weɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least we are not alone.
dialogue.zh: 至少我們不是唯一一戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the shops on the corner closed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ʃɑps ɑn ðə ˈkɔrnər kloʊzd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they shut their doors early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good evening, is your power out?
dialogue.zh: 晚安，你們家也停電了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it went out at ten thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt wɛnt aʊt æt tɛn ˈθɜrti/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you been waiting?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost twenty minutes in the dark.
dialogue.zh: 在黑暗裡快二十分鐘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know what caused this?
dialogue.zh: 你知道是什麼造成的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tree fell on the wires.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did the tree come down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near the bridge on Maple Road.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anyone hurt on that street?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, everyone got out safely.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，大家都平安出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which company should we telephone now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在該打給哪家公司？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The number is on the bill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I borrow your phone charger?
dialogue.zh: 我可以借你的手機充電器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is also almost empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone will die very soon.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機很快就要沒電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it off to save power.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we do with the food?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd wi du wɪð ðə fud?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the fridge door shut tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How cold is it inside the fridge?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ koʊld ɪz ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə frɪdʒ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold enough for one more night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can we buy some ice?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以去哪裡買冰塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gas station may have some.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the gas station open tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but it has no power.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who has a cooler we can borrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu hæz ə ˈkulər wi kæn ˈbɑroʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mrs. Lin upstairs has one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us carry the milk to her.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ˈkæri ðə mɪlk tu hɜr/
dialogue.zh: 我們把牛奶拿過去給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That will keep it cold longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have extra candles at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈɛkstrə ˈkændəlz æt hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have three on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do the pipes make noise?
dialogue.zh: 水管為什麼一直有聲音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The water pump stopped working.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we heat water tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cannot, so we wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we should sleep early tonight.
dialogue.zh: 也許今晚我們該早點睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds like a good plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time will the power return?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They promised around one o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we share one flashlight?
dialogue.zh: 我們共用一支手電筒好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we can take turns holding it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wi kæn teɪk tɜrnz ˈhoʊldɪŋ ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that your dog barking outside?
dialogue.zh: 在外面叫的是你家的狗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he hates the darkness.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the dog now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is sleeping by my feet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you think the storm is over?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju θɪŋk ðə stɔrm ɪz ˈoʊvər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rain stopped an hour ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check the hallway again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still dark, so we wait more.
dialogue.zh: 還是黑的，那我們再等等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp in the hallway flickers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the power is returning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our neighbor knocked on the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will answer it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need anything from us?
dialogue.zh: 你們需要我們幫忙什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some batteries would help a lot.
dialogue.zh: 如果有電池就幫了大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is Mrs. Lin upstairs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is eighty and lives alone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we check on her tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們該去看看她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she may need a lamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will, and I will bring water.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ænd aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ˈwɔtər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, take the small flashlight too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is her doorbell working right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, so we knock loudly.
dialogue.zh: 不能，所以我們大聲敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is her hallway so cold?
dialogue.zh: 她的走廊為什麼這麼冷？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The heating stopped with the power.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What can we bring for her?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A blanket and some tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the thermos?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is beside the front door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we boil water on the stove?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi bɔɪl ˈwɔtər ɑn ðə stoʊv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the stove is electric.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still have warm tea left?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi stɪl hæv wɔrm ti lɛft?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, about half a pot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many candles are burning now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six, one in each room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please keep them away from curtains.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I moved the curtains already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The radio works on batteries.
dialogue.zh: 這台收音機是用電池的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us listen to the news.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did the announcer just say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Power returns before the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which streets are still dark?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours and the one behind us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the hospital running normally?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it has its own generator.
dialogue.zh: 有，醫院有自己的發電機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is my phone so warm?
dialogue.zh: 我的手機為什麼這麼燙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The flashlight app drains it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us turn off the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that saves some battery.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear that truck outside?
dialogue.zh: 你聽到外面那台卡車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The repair crew has arrived.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are they working tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the broken power line.
dialogue.zh: 在那條斷掉的電線下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long until they finish?
dialogue.zh: 他們還要多久才會完成？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe another hour or so.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fridge is getting warmer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We should eat the ice cream.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a strange night this is.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least we are together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall light just flickered.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was only a flicker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the candles now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are in the kitchen drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you light the big candle?
dialogue.zh: 你可以點燃那根大蠟燭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a lighter here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any matches?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me find another one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This candle is burning too fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will light the small one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the flashlight?
dialogue.zh: 你把我的手電筒放哪了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is beside the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room looks nice with candles.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The light is soft and warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many candles do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a few will be enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is for dinner tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have cold chicken and bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you cook dinner already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I bought it this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soup is cold now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can eat it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything in the fridge?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, some fruit and cheese.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we eat first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us start with the bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the paper plates?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are on the top shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should not open the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the cold air escapes fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the water still run?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the tap works fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please pass me the salt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, next to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bread tastes a little dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can add some butter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who brought the apple juice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My friend left it here yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 我朋友昨天放在這裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plates are all dirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wash them tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we sit on the floor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the rug is soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The candle is getting short.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We still have a few more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the bottle opener?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is in the second drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we drink juice without cups?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以不用杯子喝果汁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can use these small glasses.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以用這些小杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The food is still quite fresh.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cold kept it fresh.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you feeling sleepy yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can hardly stay awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we do now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can talk for a while.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to play cards?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if you teach me first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me about your old town.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is small and very quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was your day today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was long but quite good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are you smiling like that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I just remembered something funny.
dialogue.zh: 我剛想起一件好笑的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a game we can play?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ɡeɪm wi kæn pleɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 有什麼我們能玩的遊戲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we have an old deck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you sing a quiet song?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only know a slow one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who taught you that song?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother sang it to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us share some old stories.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, you can start first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you remember our school trip?
dialogue.zh: 你還記得我們的校外教學嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we laughed the whole way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you miss the most?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I missed the warm summer nights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you tired of sitting here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I am quite comfortable.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we can tell ghost stories.
dialogue.zh: 也許我們可以講鬼故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would scare me too much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we make some warm tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that sounds really nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you learn to whistle?
dialogue.zh: 你在哪裡學會吹口哨的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My grandfather taught me years ago.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time passes slowly without lights.
dialogue.zh: 沒有燈的時候時間過得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Talking makes it feel faster.
dialogue.zh: 聊天讓時間感覺快一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like this kind of night?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju laɪk ðɪs kaɪnd əv naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it feels calm and simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a favorite memory?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our trip together last spring.
dialogue.zh: 我們去年春天一起的那趟旅行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask you something personal?
dialogue.zh: 我可以問你一件私人的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but keep it simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your voice sounds a bit sleepy.
dialogue.zh: 你的聲音聽起來有點睏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am getting tired slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we stop talking now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my eyes are closing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you enjoy our long chat?
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡我們這次長聊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it made me happy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was there anything you wanted to say?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ ju ˈwɑntɪd tu seɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, just good night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you feel about silence?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Silence helps me think clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us talk about tomorrow instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, tomorrow will be brighter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us go out to the balcony.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ aʊt tu ðə ˈbælkəni/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the night air is cool.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the stars bright tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the sky is very clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many stars can you count?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I count about twenty stars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That bright star looks like a diamond.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt braɪt stɑr lʊks laɪk ə ˈdaɪmənd/
dialogue.zh: 那顆亮星看起來像鑽石。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It might be a small planet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the moon behind the clouds?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is hidden tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that light move?
dialogue.zh: 你有看到那道光移動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it was probably a plane.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our city looks dark from here.
dialogue.zh: 從這裡看，我們的城市一片黑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every window is completely black.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I never noticed so many stars.
dialogue.zh: 我從沒注意到有這麼多星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me neither, this is beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a shooting star?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, make a wish quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You should wish for something good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already wished for quiet days.
dialogue.zh: 我已經許了平靜的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neck hurts from looking up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can sit on the chairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feel how cool the wind is.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells like rain tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you name any star?
dialogue.zh: 你能說出任何一顆星的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only know the north one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen to the crickets down there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They sing louder in the dark.
dialogue.zh: 牠們在黑暗中唱得更大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our neighbors are also outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I hear their low voices.
dialogue.zh: 有，我聽到他們低聲說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like some warm milk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that would help me sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have we been outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe an hour or so.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we go back inside now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is getting chilly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, one window just lit up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone found a working lamp.
dialogue.zh: 有人找到一盞能用的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the power is coming back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope the whole street returns.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember our camping trip last year?
dialogue.zh: 記得我們去年的露營嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we watched stars all night.
dialogue.zh: 記得，我們整晚都在看星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stars are brighter without city lights.
dialogue.zh: 沒有城市燈光，星星更亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Darkness has a strange beauty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take a deep breath of air.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels fresh and clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I could stay here all night.
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡待一整晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You would catch a cold though.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the lights are back on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finally, we can see again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen clock is blinking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, let me check the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fridge still cold enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everything inside feels fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please check the television first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turns on without any trouble.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did anything break while it was out?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈɛniˌθɪŋ breɪk waɪl ɪt wʌz aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 停電期間有東西壞掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, everything works as before.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，全部跟以前一樣正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn on the small lamp, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is already shining brightly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we charge our phones now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, mine is almost empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long was the power out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was out for a few hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz aʊt fɔr ə fju ˈaʊərz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check if the heater still works.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It makes a strange humming noise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That noise will stop in a moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt nɔɪz wɪl stɑp ɪn ə ˈmoʊmənt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope it is nothing serious.
dialogue.zh: 希望不是什麼嚴重的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything in the kitchen is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we were quite lucky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we should blow out candles.
dialogue.zh: 也許我們該把蠟燭吹熄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are not needed now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can turn off the hallway light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn tɜrn ɔf ðə ˈhɔlweɪ laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你可以把走廊的燈關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will do it right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is finally time for bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am very sleepy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please close the window tightly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the room is quiet now.
dialogue.zh: 關好了，房間現在很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you brush your teeth yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I finished a minute ago.
dialogue.zh: 有，我一分鐘前就刷好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the alarm before you sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already set it earlier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well and do not worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, good night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave a small light in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ə smɔl laɪt ɪn ðə hɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, that helps at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our room feels warm and safe.
dialogue.zh: 我們的房間感覺溫暖又安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the power is steady now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready to sleep now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, turn off the light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, sleep until morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, see you tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will check the door once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tʃɛk ðə dɔr wʌns mɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is locked, do not worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we can clean everything up.
dialogue.zh: 明天我們可以收拾一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tonight we just rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close your eyes and relax slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am already half asleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May the night be calm and quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ ðə naɪt bi kɑm ænd ˈkwaɪət/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, and sleep well too.

issues.note: 全篇唯一超過 SLEEP_MAX_LINE_WORDS=7 的行：'Let us use the phone as a light.' 共 8 詞，卡片會自動縮字；非 error 級（audit hard=0，長度僅為體檢信號），若想收乾淨可改 'Let us use the phone for light.'
131 'The water pump stopped working.' 與 229 'Yes, the tap works fine.' 略有張力；都市自來水直供時泵浦只負責加壓，兩句可並存，非矛盾，判定可保留。
約 46/200 條 b 行以 'Yes,' 開頭（3、13、25、37…），比例偏高；但屬問答式睡前循環常態、皆帶實詞而非純語氣詞，屬風格小瑕。

review.summary_zh: 本輪五處修正皆已落實（20 補冠詞 'as a light'、45 改 'The batteries are quite old.'、125 'Mrs. Lin upstairs has one.'、159 'Good, take the small flashlight too.'、350 改 'The kitchen clock is blinking.'），全篇手電筒統一為 flashlight，復電不再重複宣布，43/45 的自相矛盾已消解。時間線（十點半停電→約一點復電→關燈就寢）與人物（樓上獨居八十歲 Mrs. Lin、隔壁鄰居、狗）前後一致，A/B 對答無斷裂，四維皆無 error 級問題，僅餘 8 詞超限與 'Yes,' 開頭偏多等風格小瑕，予以 APPROVED。IPA 一項依機器證據給分（SUSPECT 0、逐詞對齊通過），未自行複核音標。
